text.jpText:
シチー、ハピバ～☆
ね、スマホ見た？
text.enText:
City, happy b-day☆ 
So, you check your phone yet?

text.jpText:
ああ、今日のタコパのこと？
ありがとね、企画。
text.enText:
Oh, you mean about today's takoyaki party? 
Thanks for planning it.

text.jpText:
ダチの誕生日なんだから当たり前っしょ！
今日はその道のプロも呼んでっし、楽しも！
text.enText:
Gotta pull out all the stops for my gal's day! 
I even called in a certified pro — this party 
'bout to be fire!
A pro? Oh, is that why ——

text.jpText:
どもー、おおきに～！
タコパのプロことタマモクロスです～！
text.enText:
Heya, pleased to be of service! 
Takoyaki pro, Tamamo Cross here!

text.jpText:
安心しとき、仕事に差し支えへんよう、
野菜たっぷりヘルシーたこ焼き作ったるわ！
text.enText:
I gotchu covered. To make sure nothing 
affects your work, I'll whip up some healthy 
takoyaki with tons of veggies!

text.jpText:
ほんで、具はどーするん？　タコに限らんで！
肌にええもん入れてみるか？　トマトとか！
text.enText:
So, whaddya wanna fill 'em with? There's 
more than just octopus! Something good 
for your skin? Tomato maybe?

text.jpText:
誕生日くらい好きなもんにしよーよ！
甘いもん好きだし～、ほらチョコとかは？
text.enText:
It's her birthday, so we can't be holding back! 
She's got a sweet tooth, so how about 
chocolate?

text.jpText:
ッカー、アンタも邪道やなー！
けどま、モノは試しや、採用！
text.enText:
Whoa there, you're an adventurous one 
too, ain'tchu? But hey, it's worth a try!

text.jpText: なんかアタシより盛り上がってない？
text.enText:
Is it just me, or are you two more excited 
about this than me?
Heh… Not that that's a bad thing.
